page.overview:
Who is Barney Gumble?

Barney Gumble is a currently deceased resident in Kingfield who was brutally murdered by Krusto as he searched for his toy boat. He made his first and only appearance in "Not It."

Like his mainstream counterpart, he was voiced by Dan Castellaneta.

When walking down the streets playing with a boat in the rain, his toy boat slides into a sewer drain, Barney wanting him to find his boat walks up to sewer, only to find Krusto, who offered to help Barney. Although then Barney undenounced as he reached his arm in the sewer, Krusto wanted to eat him. So, when Barney reached his hand in, his entire arm was ripped off, causing Barney to yell in fear as he's dragged into the sewer and brutally murdered by the violent clown.

Homer, hoping to find his friend places missing posters on a billboard in hope Barney is still alive.
